title: Adaptive Finite Elements with Algebraic Stabilization for Convection-Dominated Transport
summary: We present a numerical investigation of residual-based a posteriori error estimation for finite element discretizations of convection--diffusion equations stabilized by algebraic flux correction and related algebraic stabilization techniques. In particular, we consider AFC schemes employing the BJK and Monolithic Convex (MC) limiters and algebraically stabilized methods including MUAS, SMUAS, and the BBK approach.
